tickets.title: Evaluate appreciated shares for charitable gift
tickets.text: Evaluate Nadia Willowdoodle’s appreciated Copper Firefly Energy shares to determine suitability for her planned $18,000 Moonbadger Literacy Foundation donation.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by November 15, 2023 to evaluate appreciated shares for Nadia’s planned $18,000 Moonbadger Literacy Foundation gift before holiday travel.

tickets.title: Obtain latest restricted stock vesting details
tickets.text: Obtain the most recent restricted stock vesting confirmation or payroll withholding details from Cloudberry Kite Robotics for Nadia Willowdoodle to estimate her 2023 tax exposure.
tickets.evidence: By October 20, 2023, the latest restricted stock vesting confirmation or payroll withholding detail from Cloudberry Kite Robotics is needed to estimate 2023 tax exposure.

tickets.title: Review cash reserves and bonus allocation
tickets.text: Review Nadia Willowdoodle’s cash holdings exceeding the six‑month reserve target together with her expected bonus to compare options for college savings, taxable investments, and mortgage principal payments.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by December 8, 2023 to review cash above the stated six-month reserve target and the expected bonus for college savings, taxable investment, and mortgage principal comparisons.
